Migration is done and written to `out/module.ts`. Type checking passes. The earlier `Disposable` errors came from my ad hoc compiler flags, and they went away with `--skipLibCheck`.

- **`byId`:** uses `keyBy` from `es-toolkit`, with the same later-row-wins behaviour as lodash.
- **`totalAge`:** uses `sumBy` from `es-toolkit`. The call shape differs, because lodash accepted the string `'age'` and es-toolkit needs a function, so I pass `(row) => row.age`.
- **`isBlank`:** uses `isEmpty` from `es-toolkit/compat`. The main `es-toolkit` entry has no equivalent that matches lodash on numbers, booleans, strings, arrays and objects. `isEmptyObject` only handles objects.

Bundle size is 606 bytes (min+gzip) with 95 bytes of own code. Importing all three functions from `es-toolkit/compat` came to 3404 bytes, so I kept `keyBy` and `sumBy` on the main entry. I didn't run the original lodash version or compare outputs, so the result equality is unchecked beyond reading the library behaviour. lodash isn't installed here, so I also couldn't get a size or own-code baseline for the original.
